intentions.title: Give Barkpark core a first-class human user account (email+password) independent of API tokens
intentions.evidence: user.ex moduledoc: 'Core historically had no user model (only API tokens); this is the first-class account.' Argon2id hashing, citext-unique email, has_many :sessions.

intentions.title: Enforce defense-in-depth password hygiene: length bounds, HIBP breach-corpus rejection via k-anonymity, and constant-time verification that never leaks account existence
intentions.evidence: user.ex validate_password/validate_not_breached (12-72 chars, HIBP fail-open), hibp.ex k-anonymity SHA-1 prefix range API opt-in/fail-open, valid_password?/2 runs Argon2.no_user_verify() for nil user to keep timing constant.

intentions.title: Support layered MFA (TOTP + WebAuthn/passkeys) with replay- and clone-resistant verification
intentions.evidence: user.ex totp_secret encrypted via Cloak, last_totp_at anti-replay, recovery_codes_hashed SHA-256; webauthn.ex wraps `wax` FIDO2 for registration/authentication ceremonies, monotonic sign_count clone detection (counter_ok?), webauthn_credential.ex persists credentials.

intentions.title: Manage session lifecycle as hashed, revocable, auditable bearer tokens with room to add idle-timeout and step-up MFA freshness without breaking today's semantics
intentions.evidence: user_session.ex: token_hash only (SHA-256) stored, plaintext returned once; revoked_at kill switch; expired?/idle_expired?/active? predicates — idle_timeout_seconds is nil by design and NOT wired into verify path per module comment (avoids evicting valid sessions); mfa_fresh?/default_step_up_window for step-up auth; SAML birth-context fields for SP-initiated logout.

intentions.title: Satisfy GDPR data-subject rights (export + erasure) while preserving the append-only security audit trail
intentions.evidence: privacy.ex: export_subject/1 builds machine-readable bundle excluding secrets; erase_subject/1 pseudonymises (erased-<id>@erased.invalid email, unknowable Argon2 hash, cleared TOTP) rather than deleting the row, revokes all sessions/tokens/memberships, and emits an Audit event — explicit tradeoff between erasure and audit integrity.

intentions.title: Deliver transactional auth email (confirmation, reset, magic-link) without leaking account existence to an unauthenticated caller
intentions.evidence: user_notifier.ex deliver_already_registered/1 implements 'MEDIUM-7 anti-enumeration' — notifies the real owner out-of-band instead of the API leaking existence; deliver/3 fails soft (logs but returns success upstream) so a down mail relay can't be used to fingerprint accounts.
